items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: there was a picture sent from President Ford, and was taken of he and his wife, Betty, with the Lawson-Haggard band

ctx.x: I was told that our performance was recorded at this time in the Rose Garden, and was to be included in the archives of -- the Presidential archives.

I have to add that Ella Fitzgerald was on that bill with us, and above the plaque that I just mentioned, there was a picture sent from President Ford, and was taken of he and his wife, Betty, with the Lawson-Haggard band, and it's rather humorous because everybody comments on it, everybody was in tuxedos and the President was in full tails, except myself, and the reason for that is after our performance, not knowing we were to be photographed with the President, I changed my clothes; I was wringing wet as usual,…

And, with my western shirt and pearl buttons, I did -- when they told us we were having pictures taken, I put on a black bow tie. I really wish since -- it turned out so ridiculous that I wished I had a ten-gallon hat to go with it, for the picture. However, the picture is for posterity, and here it is, as it was taken.
